context_for_next_testing_agent: Daily Workplan feature is fully implemented and working. Backend endpoints: /api/workplan (GET/PUT), /api/workplan/publish (POST), /api/workplan/published (GET), /api/workplan/jobs (GET/POST/DELETE), /api/workplan/colors (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE).
